## GSE111976

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
GSE111976_CEuE <- readRDS("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE111976_RAW/GSE111976_ct_endo_10x.rds")

GSE111976_CEuE <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = GSE111976_CEuE, project = "GSE111976", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```

### QC

```{r}
GSE111976_CEuE[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(GSE111976_CEuE, pattern ="^MT-")
```

### QC Visualizations

```{r}
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(GSE111976_CEuE, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(GSE111976_CEuE, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

ggsave("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE111976_RAW/Visualizations/QC/GSE111976_CEuE_qc.pdf")
```

### Subset Samples

```{r}
GSE111976_CEuE <- subset(GSE111976_CEuE, subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 & nFeature_RNA < 7500 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & percent.mt < 10)
```

### Merge things
Nothing to merge
```{r}
new_names <- c("sample14", "sample19", "sample20", "sample29", "sample39","sample41","sample57","sample58","sample60","sample63")
names(new_names) <- levels(GSE111976_CEuE)

GSE111976_CEuE <- RenameIdents(object = GSE111976_CEuE, new_names)
```

### Save object
```{r}
SaveSeuratRds(GSE111976_CEuE, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE111976_RAW/QC_normalized_GSE111976_CEuE.rds")

GSE <- readRDS(file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE111976_RAW/QC_normalized_GSE111976_CEuE.rds")
```

```{r}
# Extract the cell names
cell_names <- colnames(GSE)

# Extract the part before the underscore (the patient number)
patient_number <- sub("_.*", "", cell_names)

# Add to metadata
GSE$patient_number <- patient_number

# This will create a list of Seurat objects, one per patient
GSE_by_patient <- SplitObject(GSE, split.by = "patient_number")

# Loop through the list and assign each to a new object in your environment
for (patient in names(GSE_by_patient)) {
  assign(paste0("seurat_patient_", patient), GSE_by_patient[[patient]])
}

```

#Sample 14
```{r}
# Get the expression matrix (log-normalized data)
expr_data <- GetAssayData(seurat_patient_14, slot = "counts")


# Check which cells express ESR1 and/or ESR2
esr1_expr <- expr_data["ESR1", ] > 0
esr2_expr <- expr_data["ESR2", ] > 0

# Boolean logic to define each group
both     <- esr1_expr & esr2_expr
esr1_only <- esr1_expr & !esr2_expr
esr2_only <- !esr1_expr & esr2_expr
neither  <- !esr1_expr & !esr2_expr

# Count cells in each group
counts <- list(
  ESR1_only = sum(esr1_only),
  ESR2_only = sum(esr2_only),
  Both      = sum(both),
  Neither   = sum(neither)
)

print(counts)

```
